name: Power BI MCP Server
description: Enables AI assistants to programmatically manage Power BI workspaces, reports, and dashboards while executing DAX queries and triggering dataset refreshes. It supports secure OAuth2 authentication for operations like report exporting, workspace management, and real-time push dataset updates.
